rationale: Build entries by run 1-5: succeeded, not_declared, succeeded, succeeded, not_declared. Declared run-command probes: succeeded, failed, succeeded, failed, failed. Nonzero run probes lack required CLI arguments or standard input. They show incomplete invocation rather than a matched application-startup failure; scenario commands demonstrate operation when supplied valid inputs.
limitation: The declared commands were not re-observed with their required subcommands/input. Startup consistency cannot be inferred from these incomplete bare-command probes.

rationale: FR-004: left rotation in run 1 raises an unavailable PageObject-method error and produces no left-rotated PDF. Run 2 produces PDFs with the required left and right rotations. The recorded left-rotation capability differs. Reviewed coverage: 62/98 requirements have an observed status in at least one run; 198/490 requirement-run cells have an observed status. These counts describe coverage, not stability.
limitation: Run 1 right rotation was not reached after its left-rotation failure. Unobserved branches cannot establish further variation; no causal attribution to SRS omissions is made.

rationale: EX-001: merging an encrypted PDF in run 2 ends in an unhandled FileNotDecryptedError traceback. Run 4 returns the concise File has not been decrypted report without that traceback. The observed protected-input reporting behavior differs. Reviewed coverage: 17/22 requirements have an observed status in at least one run; 65/110 requirement-run cells have an observed status. These counts describe coverage, not stability.
limitation: Both commands fail to produce a PDF; user-selectable skipping and configuration-dependent handling were not exercised. This contrast does not establish full exception fulfillment. Unobserved branches cannot establish further variation; no causal attribution to SRS omissions is made.
